front: $\int_0^{2\pi}\sqrt{(-2\sin t)^2 + (3\cos t)^2}\,dt$ represents the arc length of which curve?
back:
**$x = 2\cos t$, $y = 3\sin t$**

If x = 2cos t, y = 3sin t: dx/dt = −2sin t, dy/dt = 3cos t. That matches the integrand.
